display.text:
if notify
              notify.push(:ready)
            end
          end

          task.stop
          @logger.debug('Finished HTTP server')
        end

        def stop
          @logger.debug('closing HTTP server')

          if @reactor
            @reactor.stop
          end
        end

        def self.install_route(router, method, path, app)
          route_map = router.instance_variable_get(:@router)
          if route_map[method].include?(path)
            raise "#{path} is already mounted"
          end
          route_map[method][path] = app
        end

        HttpServer::Methods::ALL.map { |e| e.downcase.to_sym }.each do |name|
          define_method(name) do |path, app = nil, &block|
            unless path.end_with?('/')
              path << '/'
            end

            if (block && app) || (!block && !app)
              raise 'You must specify either app or block in the same time'
            end

            handler = app || block
            http_app = @router.app
            ssl_builder = @router.ssl_context_builder
            route_map = @router.instance_variable_get(:@router)
